parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of extra ticks and tick labels appearing after calling `ax.clear()` on shared axes. The change is minimal and focused on the intended fix.

issues.description: The patch introduces some minor maintainability/readability issues by adding comments and changing the order of method calls in the `clear` method.
